questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset express PART-05's two local state values, safe initialization, and pre-state-sensitive twelve-case partition with explicit earlier-priority exclusions and no second decision owner?

Can PART-07 derive both finite outputs locally from one structured TransferResolution without unsupported tuple or record operations; if not, which semantics-preserving finite representation is supported?

Can one uncredited Process, fourteen boundary-delegation routes, and six sibling connections legally realize thirteen end-to-end semantic interactions and exactly twenty concrete connections at depth two?
Can the retained dependency-free analyzer exhaust 3,072 admissible snapshots and preserve witnesses for all twelve cases and five scenario families within the run harness?

model-review.summary: The selected 7/13/12/5 allocation is realizable unchanged, and all seven usages own nonidentity local behavior.

findings.evidence: Extensionally, PART-01 and PART-02 each map four raw value/status pairs to three facts by collapsing the two invalid-status pairs; PART-03 maps eight pairs to five by collapsing four invalid pairs; PART-04 maps six pairs to four by collapsing three invalid pairs; PART-05 combines state and four qualified inputs in a twelve-case state-dependent policy; PART-06 maps twelve dispositions many-to-one to two commands; and PART-07 combines disposition and, for ActiveHolding, next phase to classify two report outputs. None is a copier, bundle-only owner, rerouter, or one-to-one enum/code rename.

SysML-AADL library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 and trusted Regulate.sysml provide Thread-local GUMBO state, initialize, compute cases, In(state), structured Data attributes, directed DataPorts, and PortConnections. Sireum v4.20260630.386eac9f has accepted the same two-state and structured-resolution pattern in terminal accepted run 20260813T013430Z-factory-dispatch-small-r1-a1.

PART-05 can publish two identically constrained TransferResolution Data ports for INT-09 and INT-10, each with attribute members nextPhase, nextRearmRequired, and disposition. PART-07 can inspect those attributes and constrain both outputs locally without tuples, recomputation, or a second decision owner; explicit earlier-priority exclusions preserve the twelve abstract cases because GUMBO compute cases are conjunctive.

One root System usage, one uncredited behavior-free Process usage, seven semantic Thread usages, fourteen boundary-delegation support routes, and six direct inter-Thread connections give exactly twenty concrete connections while realizing INT-01 through INT-13 at semantic depth two in one weakly connected region. The mapping preserves every declared INT endpoint and semantic count.

Independent enumeration covered exactly 3,072 admissible raw snapshots and produced CASE-01 through CASE-12 witness counts 2880, 46, 2, 80, 44, 1, 1, 2, 2, 4, 8, and 2. Every case is reachable; the ordered classifier is total; and a dependency-free analyzer can compare qualification, state, resolution, output, invariant, and five-family scenario results without becoming an architectural owner or a formal-proof claim.

All thirteen interfaces have compatible finite payloads and directed roles under the selected containment mapping. Separate traces for INT-09 and INT-10 plus generated-support annotations on only the fourteen routing declarations preserve trace closure and the seed claim boundary without adding physical docking, transfer, timing, execution, safety, or certification claims.
